answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by receiving a scarce, nontransferable credential after a live challenge: a random beacon assigns each applicant to a small terrace of peers, who verify its work history and stake their own credentials on the endorsement. A mesa of independent reviewers audits samples and can revoke tainted credentials, costing endorsers future influence. An attacker must therefore recruit real, accountable participants and risk losing accumulated access for each fake identity, rather than minting unlimited accounts.
